bounds: One verified owner and grant, one exact request and review digest, one durable dispatch reservation and at most one terminal provider response. Journal writes and provider callbacks are atomic steps. After restart the active owner may read the same record but has no send lease. Retiring the owner disables reads and sends. Actual journal tests cover storage conflicts, lost replies and review equality. This case excludes multi-request clearing, malformed receipt identity and changes between non-prepared replies after a terminal response.

assumptions: Weak fairness of an exact terminal receipt read and successful persistence while the owner stays current and a dispatch remains unsettled. This assumes provider progress and repeated receipt reads. An interrupted or stalled provider can remain pending in the absence of fairness.
